name: Inventory Rules for WooCommerce
author: CorvoWP

sections.description:
Inventory Rules for WooCommerce gives store owners simple, reliable quantity rules for WooCommerce products and variations.

The free plugin includes:

  • Minimum quantities
  • Maximum quantities
  • Quantity increments
  • Global defaults
  • Product-specific rules
  • Variation-specific rules
  • Cart validation
  • WooCommerce Store API quantity limits

Configure global quantity rules for your store, then override them when individual products or variations require different purchasing requirements.

Premium Add-on

For stores that need more advanced inventory rule management, a separate Inventory Rules Premium add-on is available.

Inventory Rules Premium adds features including:

  • Category rules
  • Reusable rule presets
  • Bulk rule management
  • Customer role rules
  • Scheduled rules
  • Advanced rule conditions
  • Customer purchase limits
  • Additional rule management and analytics features

The Premium add-on is separate from the free WordPress.org plugin. The free version remains fully functional without purchasing or installing the Premium add-on.

Learn more about Inventory Rules Premium

Privacy

The free plugin does not require an account or license key and does not send inventory data to a remote licensing service.

External Services

The free plugin does not contact any external service for its functionality.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate Inventory Rules for WooCommerce.
  3. Configure global defaults under Inventory Rules > Settings.
  4. Configure individual product rules from the Inventory Rules panel in the WooCommerce product editor.
sections.changelog:
1.3.4

  • Removed in-dashboard, settings-screen, product-editor and plugin-row upgrade promotions to keep the admin experience focused on the free plugin.
  • Retained the complete free Inventory Rules functionality and existing WordPress.org compatibility fixes.
